title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Open the same list in a new tab when switching companies
summary: The company switcher feature in Business Central allows users to quickly switch between companies and open the same list page in a new tab while keeping the original company context. This is useful when working across multiple companies and environments to compare data.
key_points: The company switcher pane is accessible from the upper-right corner near the search icon or via Ctrl+O keyboard shortcut
Three switching options are available: Switch (same tab), Open in new tab (keeps original open), and Open in new tab and go to same page (list pages only)
The 'Open in new tab and go to same page' option preserves your current page context when viewing the equivalent list in another company
Company switcher provides an overview of all companies across all environments you have access to
